rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the combat sport, especially as its official or named sport.

example.english: I think boxing really takes skill.
example.traditional: 拳擊係一項好講技術嘅運動。
example.jyutping: kyun4 gik1 hai6 jat1 hong6 hou2 gong2 gei6 seot6 ge3 wan6 dung6

rows.note: Use this casual expression when referring to boxing as an activity or sport people practise or watch.

example.english: I used to go boxing with my friends when I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣成日同朋友一齊打拳。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 tung4 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 daa2 kyun4
